summary: One blocking extraction defect remains: unsupported optional-argument parsing can discard printed prose and bypass both guards. Prior fixes and rebuttals were inspected. All five execution checks remain NOT_RUN as instructed.

checks.criterion: AC1: Shared LaTeX-to-prose extraction with source line numbers and required exclusions
checks.evidence: Both consumers use tex_prose.extract, but tex_prose.py:706-720 treats bracketed text as optional arguments even for commands without them. Consequently, \label[seamless]{} discards printed prose beyond the actual label argument.

checks.criterion: AC2: File coverage, finding format, failure exit and no rule-disabling option
checks.evidence: Static review: tex_prose.py:470-476 recursively selects every .tex file except figures/styles.tex. lint_prose.py:116-117 formats findings; :252-276 exposes only --root and returns 1 when findings exist.

checks.criterion: AC3: All six prose rules and TikZ-specific handling
checks.evidence: The six rules are dispatched at lint_prose.py:223-229, but the extraction defect removes seamless from \label[seamless]{}, so banned_word_hits at :161-168 receives no prohibited word. See the blocking finding.

checks.criterion: AC4: Normalization, fixed 12-token threshold, maximal runs and record handling
checks.evidence: overlap_check.py:37 fixes the threshold at 12 and :163-194 validates records, but extraction drops lunar from 'We measure the roughness of \label[lunar]{} and martian terrain at baselines from'. The rendered text has the existing test abstract's first 12 tokens; the scanner leaves only 11.
paper/reference-verification.json:1 contains exactly an object with an empty references object.

checks.criterion: AC6: Required meaningful tests, written and run failing before implementation
checks.evidence: The required cases are present in test_lint_prose.py and test_overlap_check.py. The fbf3c38 tree contains those tests importing implementation modules that are absent from that tree. Actual failing runs cannot be verified from source; checks were prohibited in this read-only review.

checks.criterion: AC7: Blocking Make targets, required order, passing manuscript and README commands
checks.evidence: paper/Makefile:5,25,43-51 establishes sequential numbers/lint/overlap/test/pdf targets; paper/README.md:22-26 documents both commands. Manuscript passes and command execution were not verified because checks were prohibited.

Static inspection confirms comment-aware argument scanning (tex_prose.py:796), retained TikZ arguments (:653), contextual group boundaries (:814), dropped control-word gaps (:846), unbraced input scanning (:752), kept-text argument gaps (:734), source-line mapping (:347,953), and scanned control-sequence matching (:454). Corresponding consumer regressions are present.

Static inspection confirms shared left-to-right accent folding at tex_prose.py:386-427, multiline accent support at :293-310, gap-aware star parsing at :722-732, and the command-specific star restriction at :710-711. Regressions cover both consumers.

checks.evidence: The enumerated story commits touch only the nine scoped paths. Bare bold declarations remain bounded control-sequence matches at lint_prose.py:105,211-215. findings.claim: Unconditional optional-argument parsing deletes printed prose after commands without optional arguments, bypassing both guards.
findings.evidence: Static trace, not executed: key_arguments_end() invokes optional_arguments_end() for label. That helper consumes [seamless], then mandatory_argument_end() consumes {}, and command() blanks the entire construct. However, \label has one undelimited argument and no optional form ([LaTeX kernel source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/latex3/latex2e/main/base/ltxref.dtx)); in \label[seamless]{}, its argument is the single '[' token and 'seamless]' prints as prose. The linter therefore misses seamless. Likewise, 'We measure the roughness of \label[lunar]{} and martian terrain at baselines from' renders the test abstract's first 12 tokens but extracts only 11, hiding the overlap. Consume optional arguments only at positions and counts supported by each command, and add extraction and consumer regressions.
